utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning to everyone. I would first of all like to ask Madam Registrar to call the case number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is the case number, IT-96-23/2-PT, the Prosecutor versus Radovan Stankovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I'm now going to address the parties for the appearances for the sake of the transcript. First of all, it's the turn of the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WUBBEN
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WUBBEN
utterances.text: My name is Jan Wubben, senior trial attorney on behalf of the Prosecution team. At my side, Daryl Mundis, attorney, and Djurdja Mirkovic, case manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] And now I will turn to Defence counsel, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. RADOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I am Milenko Radovic from Foca. I am Defence counsel for Mr. Radovan Stankovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Pursuant to the order of the 12th of March, 2003, the hearing of today will be dedicated to a further Initial Appearance of the accused, further to the modification of the amendment -- of the indictment by the Trial Chamber dated the 28th of February, 2003. I'd like to remind the parties that during the last appearance held on the 6th of March, 2003 and having read the indictment, the accused stated that he wasn't in a position to express himself with regard to the indictment. He was, therefore, granted 30 days in order to enter a plea pursuant to Rule 62 of the rules. This hearing will, therefore, be dedicated to the further Initial Appearance of the accused. I would also like to remind you that following objections made by the Defence on the 12th of March, 2003 with regard to the amended indictment, the Trial Chamber rendered its decision dated the 2nd of April, 2003, and its objections were rejected by the Trial Chamber. I would now like to turn to Mr. Stankovic. Good day. And I would like to ask you: Are you ready --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to ask you whether you are ready to enter a plea for each count today, and I would like to remind you that this hearing is dedicated to -- concerns entering a plea of guilty or not guilty, regardless of all the Defence case, all the Defence issues that you could develop and expand on before this Trial Chamber. Yes, please. Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I do want to enter a plea today. But Mr. El Mahdi, Judge el, why should I enter a plea on two occasions, since I have already entered a plea with regard that this indictment when I appeared for the first time last year? I don't see anything new here. You see here it says, "Enslavement and rape" here. "FWS-75, -87 -- A.S. -- J.B., J.G., and other women in Karaman's house." And then it says the, "Expanded indictment --"

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stankovic, just a minute, please. Just a minute. Could you please follow me. I am now asking you - and this is my sole question - whether you're going to enter a plea for each count, a plea of guilty or not guilty. These counts are going to be read out to you, only the counts because you have become very familiar with the indictment that was read out to you in its entirety at the last hearing. So please, in accordance with the rules, I would like to ask Madam Registrar now to read out each count and only each count and you should enter a plea of guilty or not guilty. Please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could I just express what my position is with regard to the entire indictment? Could I just enter a plea with regard to the entire indictment, rather than go through each count individually?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So that I can be sure that you have understood the significance of your plea and to be sure that for each count you are entering a plea that you consider to be the right one, the result would be the same. But according to the rules, if you -- we should read out each count and then you can enter the plea that you like. That's how we should proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. El Mahdi, I don't want to express my position, enter a plea with regard to the amended indictment at all. I am guilty because I am a Serb. That is something that I already said at the last appearance, the last time I had to enter a plea. I am guilty because I am a Serb and because I was defending my Serbian people and my state, the Greater Serbia which was formerly and legally called Yugoslavia, and as such was internationally recognised.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stankovic, I'm going to repeat this. This is a matter for Defence. And I would like you to follow carefully, when each count is being read out, and you are to enter a plea having given this due consideration. Please do not be impulsive, do not be rash, reflect about the matter, and enter the plea that you consider to be the right one in your opinion. So I'm going to ask Madam Registrar to read out --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Excuse me. Do I have the right not to express a position, not to enter a plea with regard to the indictment?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You are absolutely right. You can enter any plea that you like. Madam Registrar, could you please read out the counts in the indictment.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 1: Enslavement, a crime against humanity punishable under Article 5(c) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: How do you plea, Mr. Stankovic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't want to enter a plea with regard to this indictment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Very well. I would like to inform you that if you don't enter a plea, it will be my duty, I will be obliged, to enter a plea of not guilty in your name. That is what is specified in the rules. So the second count, please, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 2: Rape. Rape, a crime against humanity punishable under Article 5(g) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] How do you plea, Mr. Stankovic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't want to enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Yes, madam, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 3: Rape. Rape, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't want to enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madam, the fourth count, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 4: Outrages upon personal dignity, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea, please?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't want to enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Madam, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 5: Enslavement, a crime against humanity Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. punishable under Article 5(c) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is something that you read out in count 1 already, so I would have to enter a plea on two occasions with regard to the same indictment. That's what I said a minute ago.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] But please, how do you plea?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't want to enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Madam Registrar, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 6: Rape, a crime against humanity punishable under Article 5(g) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is also repetition, and I don't want to enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Yes, Madam Registrar, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 7: Rape, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea, please?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have already expressed my position. I did so a minute ago. And I don't want to express it again. I don't want to enter a plea again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Thank you. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 8: Outrages upon personal dignity, a violation of the laws and customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Mr. Stankovic, how do you plea?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have already stated what my position is and I won't repeat it. I won't enter a plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Very well then. So in your name and according to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, I will enter a plea of not guilty and I will do so in your name. I would like to ask Madam Registrar to go into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Thank you very much. I do not think that there is anything else on this agenda, and therefore, the session is adjourned. Thank you very much.
